title: Addition
description: One word this site adds to the vocabulary on top of the pinned English OpenList revision. One line of data/vocabulary/additions.jsonl. Every addition is public, carries a meaning a reader can read, and names where it came from; the operator accepts it by merging the pull request that adds it.

word.description: The search form, already normalized: lowercase, accents folded, nothing else. A word that normalize() would change is not a legal addition.

kind.description: loanword: a word English has borrowed from another language and uses as its own. later-in-openlist: English OpenList has since accepted the word, so the next build drops the duplicate and this line becomes a record.

gloss.description: What the word means, in one sentence. A reader sees this in the word panel, so PRODUCT.md's rule applies: a capital letter at the start and a full stop at the end.

trace.description: Where the word is attested: a public URL (Wiktionary, Urban Dictionary, a citation), an explicit coinage note, or — for later-in-openlist — the English OpenList revision that accepted it.

proposed_by.description: Who proposed it. The routine and the Submit page propose; only a merge admits.

note.description: Anything else worth recording about the admission.
